chunks: the right of those Muslims who are around you and those who are around me in the distribution of this booty is equal; they come to me regarding it and take from it.

key_terms.الْفَيْءِ: booty/gains (specifically from non-combatants or conquered lands)

ai.seo_question: How should war booty be distributed among local and accompanying Muslims according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the principle of egalitarian distribution of war booty (fay') among all Muslims, regardless of their geographic origin, thereby rejecting tribal or regional favoritism. This directive underscores the governor's role as a transparent administrator who ensures that the community has direct access to the central treasury, reflecting the early Islamic ideal of social justice and unity under the Caliphate.
